# **I. Overview** {#i.-overview}

## **1\. Code Packages** {#1.-code-packages}

The TuConnector backend is a Node.js / Express 5 REST API written in ES modules and persisted in MongoDB Atlas through Mongoose 8\. It follows a layered architecture: each HTTP request passes through routes (with authentication and validation middleware), controllers, services and repositories before reaching the Mongoose models. The diagram below shows the packages of the backend sub-system (backend/src); packages marked "planned" are defined by the SRS architecture but do not exist in the repository yet.

![][image2]

*Figure 1\. Backend package diagram*

***Package descriptions***

| No | Package | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | config | Application configuration: environment.js reads environment variables (port, MongoDB URI, JWT secret, CORS origin); database.js opens and reports the Mongoose connection to MongoDB Atlas. |
| 02 | routes | Express routers, one file per feature (\<feature\>.routes.js) mounted by index.routes.js under /api/\<feature\>/v1. Declares endpoints and attaches middleware (authentication, Zod validator). |
| 03 | controllers | HTTP layer, one file per feature (\<feature\>.controller.js). Reads the request, calls the service and returns the unified response (responseCommon). No business logic. |
| 04 | services | Business logic per feature (\<feature\>.service.js): applies business rules (BR-01..BR-17), coordinates repositories and external integrations, throws AppError on rule violations. |
| 05 | repositories | Data-access layer per feature (\<feature\>.repository.js): all MongoDB queries (find, aggregate, transactions) through Mongoose models. Currently empty in the repository; services will be refactored to use it. |
| 06 | models | Mongoose models, one file per collection (37 collections, PascalCase file names such as User.js, PaymentOrder.js), enums.js with every enum value, index.js re-exporting all models. Field names are snake\_case as in the database. |
| 07 | models/schemas | Sub-schemas for embedded documents (\<SubDoc\>.schema.js), e.g. Experience, Education, Subscription, Receipt, SessionAttendance, AssignmentQuestion. |
| 08 | common/middlewares | Cross-cutting Express middleware: auth.middleware.js (JWT authentication, role on req.user), error.middleware.js (404 and global error handler). |
| 09 | common/validator | Request validation with Zod: validator.js (generic middleware) and \<feature\>Schema.js (request schemas, e.g. authSchema.js). |
| 10 | common/utils | Shared helpers: AppError (error with HTTP status and field errors), asyncHandler (forwards async errors to the error handler). |
| 11 | common/constants, common/response.js | Shared constants (response codes) and responseCommon, the unified JSON response format {success, message, data}. |
| 12 | integrations (planned) | Clients for external systems: VNPay payment gateway (currently called from payment.controller.js), Google Gemini, Google OAuth / Calendar, Email / SMS service. |
| 13 | jobs (planned) | Background jobs with node-cron: expire pending payment orders and old requests, session reminders, monthly credit grant / expiry. |
| 14 | sockets (planned) | Socket.IO gateway for real-time chat messages and notifications. |
| 15 | tests | Automated tests: tests/unit and tests/integration (node \--test). |

**Naming conventions**

\- **Files:** camelCase feature name \+ layer suffix: \<feature\>.routes.js, \<feature\>.controller.js, \<feature\>.service.js, \<feature\>.repository.js, \<feature\>Schema.js (validator).

\- **Models:** PascalCase singular model name per collection (User, TutorProfile, PaymentOrder); sub-schemas end with .schema.js. The MongoDB collection name is set explicitly with the collection option (e.g. PAYMENT\_ORDERS).

\- **Fields:** snake\_case, identical to the database (e.g. tutor\_profile\_id, created\_at); timestamps are mapped to created\_at / updated\_at.

\- **Functions:** camelCase verbs (createRequest, applyToRequest); controllers export one handler per endpoint wrapped by asyncHandler.

\- **Routes:** /api/\<feature\>/v1/\<resource\> in kebab-case (e.g. /api/payment/v1/get-payment-url).

\- **Constants and enums:** UPPER\_SNAKE\_CASE values grouped in models/enums.js (ENUMS.UserRole.TUTOR).

## **2\. Database Design** {#2.-database-design}

### ***a. Database Schema*** {#a.-database-schema}

TuConnector stores its data in MongoDB Atlas (database tuconnector). The schema below is the physical design implemented by docs/database/init\_tuconnector.js (collection validators and indexes) and backend/src/models: 37 collections; child entities that are always read with their parent are embedded as sub-documents (green, dashed) instead of separate collections. Only key fields are shown (PK \_id, FK references, unique keys, embedded fields); the full field list is in Table 11 of the SRS and in the model files.

*Note: the template asks for MySQL naming; this project uses MongoDB, so collection names follow the convention of the init script (UPPER\_SNAKE\_CASE plural, e.g. PAYMENT\_ORDERS; the user collection is named User) and field names are snake\_case.*

![][image3]  
*Figure 2\. Database schema (MongoDB, embedded design – ERD v3)*

### ***b. Table Description*** {#b.-table-description}

| No | Table | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | User | Shared account of every role (Parent, Tutor, Student, Admin): login credentials, role, account status and login lock. Embeds google\_account, credit\_wallet (credit balance), notification\_preferences, subscription (current plan, AI quota) and student\_profile. |
| 02 | EMAIL\_VERIFICATION\_TOKENS | One-time tokens / OTPs to verify the email address after registration (TTL index on expired\_at). |
| 03 | USER\_SESSIONS | Login sessions per device with the refresh token and revocation status (TTL index on expires\_at). |
| 04 | PASSWORD\_RESET\_TOKENS | One-time tokens to reset a password; also used to unlock an account locked after 5 failed logins (BR-02). |
| 05 | TUTOR\_PROFILES | Public tutor profile (1-1 with User): headline, bio, address, availability, completion flag and average rating. Embeds experiences, achievements and educations. |
| 06 | SAVED\_SEARCHES | Tutor-search filters saved by a parent. |
| 07 | REVIEWS | Parent review of a tutor for one confirmed tutoring agreement (unique agreement\_id): rating, sub-ratings, comment, tutor reply and moderation status. |
| 08 | TUTOR\_POSTS | Teaching-service posts of a tutor (subject, grade, mode, price, schedule) shown in search results. |
| 09 | PARENT\_REQUESTS | Tutoring requests posted by parents (subject, grade, mode, location, schedule, budget, tutor requirements) with their lifecycle status. |
| 10 | AI\_SUGGESTIONS | Cached AI suggestions of tutors / posts for a parent request, with match score and reason. |
| 11 | CONVERSATIONS | 1-1 parent–tutor conversations (opened by Continue) and class group chats (unique class\_id). Embeds read\_states per user. |
| 12 | APPLY\_REQUESTS | Tutor applications to a parent request with a note and match score; status PENDING / CONTINUED / SKIPPED / WITHDRAWN (unique request \+ tutor). |
| 13 | BOOKMARKED\_REQUESTS | Parent requests bookmarked by tutors (unique tutor \+ request). |
| 14 | AI\_POST\_SUGGESTIONS | Cached AI suggestions of requests that fit a tutor ("Suggested for you"). |
| 15 | TUTOR\_INVITATIONS | Invitations from a parent to a tutor for a request; status PENDING / ACCEPTED / DECLINED / CANCELLED (unique request \+ tutor). |
| 16 | TUTORING\_AGREEMENTS | Agreement proposed in a conversation and confirmed by the other side (agreed subject, schedule, price); status DRAFT / PENDING / CONFIRMED / REJECTED / CANCELLED. |
| 17 | PAYMENT\_ORDERS | Payment orders of tutors and parents for a plan (with duration) or credit packs (with quantity): amount, method, status and gateway data. Embeds receipt. |
| 18 | PLANS | Subscription plans per role (TUTOR / PARENT): monthly price, monthly credits, AI quota, SMS reminders, maximum classrooms. |
| 19 | CREDIT\_PACKS | Credit top-up packs for one role or both (null target\_role). |
| 20 | CREDIT\_TRANSACTIONS | Credit history of a user: monthly grant, purchase, spent on an application or invitation, expired grant. |
| 21 | CLASSROOMS | Online classes created by tutors, optionally linked to an agreement, with join code and invite link (unique). Embeds material topics. |
| 22 | CLASS\_MEMBERS | Students and parents of a class and their membership status. |
| 23 | CLASS\_ANNOUNCEMENTS | Announcements posted by the tutor in a class, can be pinned. |
| 24 | CLASS\_MATERIALS | Learning materials of a class (document, slide, video, link), grouped by topic. |
| 25 | ASSIGNMENTS | Class assignments (manual or AI-generated) with due date, points and late / resubmission rules. Embeds questions and attachments. |
| 26 | ASSIGNMENT\_SUBMISSIONS | A student submission per attempt with status, scores and feedback. Embeds answers. |
| 27 | RECURRING\_RULES | Recurring schedule rules of a class (days of week, start time, duration, end date). |
| 28 | CLASS\_SESSIONS | Individual class sessions (time, meeting link, status). Embeds attendance. |
| 29 | SCHEDULE\_CHANGE\_REQUESTS | Requests from students / parents to move or cancel a session and the tutor response. |
| 30 | SESSION\_REMINDERS | Scheduled email / SMS reminders for sessions and their sending status. |
| 31 | USER\_CALENDAR\_TOKENS | Google Calendar tokens of a user (1-1 with User). |
| 32 | SESSION\_CALENDAR\_SYNC | Sync status of a session to a user Google Calendar event. |
| 33 | MESSAGES | Messages of a conversation (text, image, file, contact card). Embeds attachments. |
| 34 | NOTIFICATIONS | In-app notifications of a user with category and target. Embeds delivery\_logs per channel. |
| 35 | PARENT\_CHILD\_LINKS | Links between a parent and a student account (PENDING / ACCEPTED / DECLINED). |
| 36 | ADMIN\_AUDIT\_LOGS | Audit log of administrator actions (MODERATE\_CONTENT, WARN\_USER, LOCK\_USER, UNLOCK\_USER, UPDATE\_PLAN, UPDATE\_SETTINGS) with reason and details. |
| 37 | CONTENT\_REPORTS | Content reports from users or the content filter (post, request, review, message, user, classroom) and the admin resolution. |

# **II. Code Designs** {#ii.-code-designs}

## **1\. Authentication & Profile**

### ***1.1 Register Account (UC01)***

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

![][image4]

*Figure 3\. Register Account – class diagram*

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

##### **AuthRoutes Class**

Express router mounted at /api/auth/v1. Maps each authentication endpoint to an AuthController handler and attaches the validator / authentication middleware.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | POST /register | validator(registerSchema) → AuthController.register |
| 02 | POST /verify-email | AuthController.verifyEmail |
| 03 | POST /resend-verification | validator(emailSchema) → AuthController.resendVerification |

##### **ValidatorMiddleware Class**

Generic request-validation middleware. Receives a Zod schema, validates req.body and either replaces req.body with the parsed DTO or stops the request with AppError 422 and field errors. Controllers therefore always receive a valid DTO.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | validator | Input: Zod schema. Output: Express middleware (req, res, next). Processing: schema.safeParse(req.body); on success req.body \= parsed data and next(); on failure next(AppError(message, 422, fieldErrors)). |

##### **AuthSchema Class**

Zod schemas (DTO definitions) of the authentication requests. Format checks only; business checks (email exists, account locked…) are done in AuthService.

| No | Schema (static field) | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | registerSchema | { full\_name: string 1–100, email: email, password: 8–64 chars with upper, lower, digit (BR-01), role ∈ {PARENT, TUTOR, STUDENT} } |
| 02 | emailSchema | { email: email } – used by resend-verification and forgot-password |

##### **AuthController Class**

HTTP layer of authentication. Reads body / cookies, calls AuthService, sets or clears the refresh-token cookie and returns responseCommon. Every handler is wrapped by asyncHandler.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | register | Input: body {full\_name, email, password, role}. Calls AuthService.register; returns 201 with the created user (without password\_hash). |
| 02 | verifyEmail | Input: body {token}. Calls AuthService.verifyEmail; returns 200 "Email verified". |
| 03 | resendVerification | Input: body {email}. Calls AuthService.resendVerification; always returns 200 with a neutral message. |

##### **AuthService Class**

Business logic of registration, login, sessions and passwords. Applies BR-01 (unique email, password policy), BR-02 (lockout after 5 failed logins until reset) and BR-03 (one-time tokens: verification 24 h, reset 15 min).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | register | Checks email uniqueness (BR-01), hashes the password, creates User {email\_verify\_status:false, has\_password:true, account\_status:ACTIVE}; for role TUTOR also creates an empty TutorProfile; creates an email-verification token (24 h) and sends the verification email. Throws 409 if the email exists. |
| 02 | verifyEmail | Finds an unused, unexpired token by its hash; marks it used and sets User.email\_verify\_status \= true. Throws 400 if invalid / expired (UC01 E3). |
| 03 | resendVerification | If an unverified user exists: invalidates previous tokens, issues a new 24 h token and sends the email. Never reveals whether the email exists. |

##### **UserRepository Class**

Data access for the User collection.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findByEmail | User.findOne({email}), optionally .select("+password\_hash"). |
| 02 | create | User.create(data). |
| 03 | updateById | User.findByIdAndUpdate(id, update, {new: true}). |

##### **EmailVerificationTokenRepository Class**

Data access for EMAIL\_VERIFICATION\_TOKENS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | create | EmailVerificationToken.create({user\_id, token\_value, expired\_at, is\_used: false}). |
| 02 | findValid | EmailVerificationToken.findOne({token\_value, is\_used: false, expired\_at: {\$gt: now}}). |
| 03 | markUsed | EmailVerificationToken.updateOne({\_id}, {\$set: {is\_used: true}}). |
| 04 | invalidateAll | EmailVerificationToken.updateMany({user\_id, is\_used: false}, {\$set: {is\_used: true}}). |

##### **TutorProfileRepository Class**

Data access for TUTOR\_PROFILES and its embedded arrays.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | createEmpty | TutorProfile.create({user\_id, is\_complete: false}). |

##### **CryptoUtil Class**

Password hashing and random one-time tokens.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | hashPassword | bcrypt.hash(plain, 10). |
| 02 | generateToken | crypto.randomBytes(32) as hex; the raw value is sent by email / cookie. |
| 03 | sha256 | Hash stored in the database instead of the raw token. |

##### **EmailClient Class**

Sends transactional emails through the SMTP / SendGrid provider.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | sendVerificationEmail | Sends the account-verification link (UC01). |

##### **User Class**

Mongoose model of the User collection (embeds google\_account, student\_profile, …).

Fields used: \_id: ObjectId, full\_name: String, email: String {unique}, password\_hash: String, email\_verify\_status: Boolean, role: UserRole, account\_status: ACTIVE\|SUSPENDED\|BANNED, failed\_login\_attempts: Int32, is\_login\_locked: Boolean, has\_password: Boolean, last\_login\_at: Date, google\_account: GoogleAccount.

##### **EmailVerificationToken Class**

Model of EMAIL\_VERIFICATION\_TOKENS.

Fields used: user\_id: ObjectId, token\_value: String {unique}, expired\_at: Date (TTL), is\_used: Boolean.

##### **TutorProfile Class**

Model of TUTOR\_PROFILES (embeds experiences, educations, achievements).

Fields used: user\_id: ObjectId {unique}, headline: String, bio: String, address: String, is\_address\_hidden: Boolean, is\_complete: Boolean, availability\_status: AVAILABLE\|NOT\_AVAILABLE, experiences: Experience\[\], educations: Education\[\], achievements: Achievement\[\].

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image5]

*Figure 4\. Register Account – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Check email uniqueness | User.findOne({ email }) |
| 02 | Create account | User.create({ full\_name, email, password\_hash, role, has\_password: true, email\_verify\_status: false, account\_status: "ACTIVE", failed\_login\_attempts: 0, is\_login\_locked: false }) |
| 03 | Create empty tutor profile (role TUTOR) | TutorProfile.create({ user\_id, is\_complete: false }) |
| 04 | Store verification token (24 h) | EmailVerificationToken.create({ user\_id, token\_value: sha256(token), expired\_at: now \+ 24h, is\_used: false }) |
| 05 | Find valid token | EmailVerificationToken.findOne({ token\_value: sha256(token), is\_used: false, expired\_at: { \$gt: new Date() } }) |
| 06 | Activate account | User.updateOne({ \_id: user\_id }, { \$set: { email\_verify\_status: true } }); EmailVerificationToken.updateOne({ \_id }, { \$set: { is\_used: true } }) |
| 07 | Invalidate old tokens before resend | EmailVerificationToken.updateMany({ user\_id, is\_used: false }, { \$set: { is\_used: true } }) |

### ***1.2 Login, Google Login & Logout (UC02)***

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

![][image6]

*Figure 5\. Login, Google Login & Logout – class diagram*

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

##### **AuthRoutes Class**

Express router mounted at /api/auth/v1. Maps each authentication endpoint to an AuthController handler and attaches the validator / authentication middleware.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | POST /login | validator(loginSchema) → AuthController.login |
| 02 | POST /google | validator(googleLoginSchema) → AuthController.loginWithGoogle |
| 03 | POST /refresh | AuthController.refresh (refresh token from httpOnly cookie) |
| 04 | POST /logout | authentication → AuthController.logout |

##### **ValidatorMiddleware Class**

Generic request-validation middleware. Receives a Zod schema, validates req.body and either replaces req.body with the parsed DTO or stops the request with AppError 422 and field errors. Controllers therefore always receive a valid DTO.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | validator | Input: Zod schema. Output: Express middleware (req, res, next). Processing: schema.safeParse(req.body); on success req.body \= parsed data and next(); on failure next(AppError(message, 422, fieldErrors)). |

##### **AuthSchema Class**

Zod schemas (DTO definitions) of the authentication requests. Format checks only; business checks (email exists, account locked…) are done in AuthService.

| No | Schema (static field) | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | loginSchema | { email: email, password: string 8–64 } |
| 02 | googleLoginSchema | { idToken: string, role?: PARENT \| TUTOR \| STUDENT } |

##### **AuthController Class**

HTTP layer of authentication. Reads body / cookies, calls AuthService, sets or clears the refresh-token cookie and returns responseCommon. Every handler is wrapped by asyncHandler.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | login | Input: body {email, password}. Calls AuthService.login; sets refresh\_token as httpOnly cookie, returns {user, accessToken}. |
| 02 | loginWithGoogle | Input: body {idToken, role?}. Calls AuthService.loginWithGoogle; returns {user, accessToken} or 200 {needRole: true} for a new Google user without role. |
| 03 | refresh | Input: cookie refresh\_token. Calls AuthService.refreshSession; rotates the cookie and returns a new accessToken. |
| 04 | logout | Input: cookie refresh\_token. Calls AuthService.logout and clears the cookie. |

##### **AuthService Class**

Business logic of registration, login, sessions and passwords. Applies BR-01 (unique email, password policy), BR-02 (lockout after 5 failed logins until reset) and BR-03 (one-time tokens: verification 24 h, reset 15 min).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | login | Finds the user by email; rejects SUSPENDED / BANNED, unverified or locked (is\_login\_locked) accounts; compares the password; on failure increments failed\_login\_attempts and locks at 5 (BR-02); on success resets the counter, sets last\_login\_at and creates a session. |
| 02 | loginWithGoogle | Verifies the Google ID token; finds the user by google\_account.google\_id or email (linking the account); creates a verified user without password when new (role required); then creates a session. |
| 03 | refreshSession | Finds an active, unexpired session for the token hash, revokes it and creates a new one (rotation). |
| 04 | logout | Revokes the session of the refresh token. |
| 05 | createSession | (private) Signs a 30-min access token, generates a 7-day refresh token and stores its hash in USER\_SESSIONS. |

##### **UserRepository Class**

Data access for the User collection.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findByEmail | User.findOne({email}), optionally .select("+password\_hash"). |
| 02 | findByGoogleIdOrEmail | User.findOne({\$or: \[{"google\_account.google\_id": googleId}, {email}\]}). |
| 03 | create | User.create(data). |
| 04 | registerFailedLogin | Atomic \$inc failed\_login\_attempts; sets is\_login\_locked when the result reaches 5\. |
| 05 | resetLoginState | \$set {failed\_login\_attempts: 0, is\_login\_locked: false, last\_login\_at: now}. |

##### **SessionRepository Class**

Data access for USER\_SESSIONS (refresh-token sessions).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | create | UserSession.create({...}). |
| 02 | findActive | UserSession.findOne({refresh\_token, is\_revoked: false, expires\_at: {\$gt: now}}). |
| 03 | revoke | UserSession.updateOne({\_id}, {\$set: {is\_revoked: true}}). |

##### **CryptoUtil Class**

Password hashing and random one-time tokens.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | comparePassword | bcrypt.compare. |
| 02 | generateToken | crypto.randomBytes(32) as hex; the raw value is sent by email / cookie. |
| 03 | sha256 | Hash stored in the database instead of the raw token. |

##### **JwtUtil Class**

Signs and verifies JWT access tokens.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | signAccessToken | jwt.sign({sub: user.\_id, role: user.role}, JWT\_SECRET, {expiresIn: "30m"}). |

##### **GoogleOAuthClient Class**

Verifies Google sign-in ID tokens.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | verifyIdToken | Uses Google OAuth2 client; returns {google\_id, email, name, picture}; throws 401 when invalid. |

##### **AuthMiddleware Class**

Authentication and role authorization.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | authentication | Reads "Authorization: Bearer \<token\>", verifies it with JwtUtil and sets req.user \= {id, role}. |

##### **User Class**

Mongoose model of the User collection (embeds google\_account, student\_profile, …).

Fields used: \_id: ObjectId, full\_name: String, email: String {unique}, password\_hash: String, email\_verify\_status: Boolean, role: UserRole, account\_status: ACTIVE\|SUSPENDED\|BANNED, failed\_login\_attempts: Int32, is\_login\_locked: Boolean, has\_password: Boolean, last\_login\_at: Date, google\_account: GoogleAccount.

##### **UserSession Class**

Model of USER\_SESSIONS.

Fields used: user\_id: ObjectId, refresh\_token: String {unique}, is\_revoked: Boolean, expires\_at: Date (TTL).

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image7]

*Figure 6\. Login, Google Login & Logout – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Find user with password | User.findOne({ email }).select("+password\_hash") |
| 02 | Wrong password (BR-02) | User.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id }, \[{ \$set: { failed\_login\_attempts: { \$add: \["\$failed\_login\_attempts", 1\] } } }, { \$set: { is\_login\_locked: { \$gte: \["\$failed\_login\_attempts", 5\] } } }\], { new: true }) |
| 03 | Successful login | User.updateOne({ \_id }, { \$set: { failed\_login\_attempts: 0, last\_login\_at: new Date() } }) |
| 04 | Create session (7 days) | UserSession.create({ user\_id, refresh\_token: sha256(refreshToken), is\_revoked: false, expires\_at: now \+ 7d }) |
| 05 | Google login – find / link user | User.findOne({ \$or: \[{ "google\_account.google\_id": googleId }, { email }\] }); User.updateOne({ \_id }, { \$set: { google\_account: { google\_id, google\_email } } }) |
| 06 | Refresh / logout | UserSession.findOne({ refresh\_token: sha256(rt), is\_revoked: false, expires\_at: { \$gt: new Date() } }); UserSession.updateOne({ \_id }, { \$set: { is\_revoked: true } }) |

### ***1.3 Forgot / Reset Password (UC03)***

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

![][image8]

*Figure 7\. Forgot / Reset Password – class diagram*

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

##### **AuthRoutes Class**

Express router mounted at /api/auth/v1. Maps each authentication endpoint to an AuthController handler and attaches the validator / authentication middleware.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | POST /forgot-password | validator(emailSchema) → AuthController.forgotPassword |
| 02 | POST /reset-password | validator(resetPasswordSchema) → AuthController.resetPassword |

##### **ValidatorMiddleware Class**

Generic request-validation middleware. Receives a Zod schema, validates req.body and either replaces req.body with the parsed DTO or stops the request with AppError 422 and field errors. Controllers therefore always receive a valid DTO.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | validator | Input: Zod schema. Output: Express middleware (req, res, next). Processing: schema.safeParse(req.body); on success req.body \= parsed data and next(); on failure next(AppError(message, 422, fieldErrors)). |

##### **AuthSchema Class**

Zod schemas (DTO definitions) of the authentication requests. Format checks only; business checks (email exists, account locked…) are done in AuthService.

| No | Schema (static field) | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | emailSchema | { email: email } – used by resend-verification and forgot-password |
| 02 | resetPasswordSchema | { token: string, newPassword: BR-01 policy } |

##### **AuthController Class**

HTTP layer of authentication. Reads body / cookies, calls AuthService, sets or clears the refresh-token cookie and returns responseCommon. Every handler is wrapped by asyncHandler.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | forgotPassword | Input: body {email}. Calls AuthService.forgotPassword; always returns 200 "If the email exists, a reset link has been sent". |
| 02 | resetPassword | Input: body {token, newPassword}. Calls AuthService.resetPassword; returns 200\. |

##### **AuthService Class**

Business logic of registration, login, sessions and passwords. Applies BR-01 (unique email, password policy), BR-02 (lockout after 5 failed logins until reset) and BR-03 (one-time tokens: verification 24 h, reset 15 min).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | forgotPassword | If the user exists: invalidates old reset tokens, creates a 15-minute token (BR-03) and emails the reset link. Neutral response otherwise (UC03 E1). |
| 02 | resetPassword | Validates the token (unused, unexpired); hashes and saves the new password, sets has\_password \= true, unlocks the account (is\_login\_locked \= false, failed\_login\_attempts \= 0), marks the token used and revokes all sessions (UC03 POST-1, BR-02). |

##### **UserRepository Class**

Data access for the User collection.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findByEmail | User.findOne({email}), optionally .select("+password\_hash"). |
| 02 | updateById | User.findByIdAndUpdate(id, update, {new: true}). |

##### **PasswordResetTokenRepository Class**

Data access for PASSWORD\_RESET\_TOKENS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | invalidateAll | PasswordResetToken.updateMany({user\_id, is\_used: false}, {\$set: {is\_used: true}}). |
| 02 | create | PasswordResetToken.create({user\_id, token\_value, expired\_at, is\_used: false}). |
| 03 | findValid | PasswordResetToken.findOne({token\_value, is\_used: false, expired\_at: {\$gt: now}}). |
| 04 | markUsed | PasswordResetToken.updateOne({\_id}, {\$set: {is\_used: true}}). |

##### **SessionRepository Class**

Data access for USER\_SESSIONS (refresh-token sessions).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | revokeAllByUser | UserSession.updateMany({user\_id, is\_revoked: false, \_id: {\$ne: exceptId}}, {\$set: {is\_revoked: true}}). |

##### **CryptoUtil Class**

Password hashing and random one-time tokens.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | generateToken | crypto.randomBytes(32) as hex; the raw value is sent by email / cookie. |
| 02 | sha256 | Hash stored in the database instead of the raw token. |
| 03 | hashPassword | bcrypt.hash(plain, 10). |

##### **EmailClient Class**

Sends transactional emails through the SMTP / SendGrid provider.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | sendResetPasswordEmail | Sends the password-reset link (UC03). |

##### **User Class**

Mongoose model of the User collection (embeds google\_account, student\_profile, …).

Fields used: \_id: ObjectId, full\_name: String, email: String {unique}, password\_hash: String, email\_verify\_status: Boolean, role: UserRole, account\_status: ACTIVE\|SUSPENDED\|BANNED, failed\_login\_attempts: Int32, is\_login\_locked: Boolean, has\_password: Boolean, last\_login\_at: Date, google\_account: GoogleAccount.

##### **PasswordResetToken Class**

Model of PASSWORD\_RESET\_TOKENS.

Fields used: user\_id: ObjectId, token\_value: String {unique}, expired\_at: Date (TTL), is\_used: Boolean.

##### **UserSession Class**

Model of USER\_SESSIONS.

Fields used: user\_id: ObjectId, refresh\_token: String {unique}, is\_revoked: Boolean, expires\_at: Date (TTL).

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image9]

*Figure 8\. Forgot / Reset Password – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Find user | User.findOne({ email }) |
| 02 | Invalidate old reset tokens | PasswordResetToken.updateMany({ user\_id, is\_used: false }, { \$set: { is\_used: true } }) |
| 03 | Store reset token (15 min) | PasswordResetToken.create({ user\_id, token\_value: sha256(token), expired\_at: now \+ 15min, is\_used: false }) |
| 04 | Validate token | PasswordResetToken.findOne({ token\_value: sha256(token), is\_used: false, expired\_at: { \$gt: new Date() } }) |
| 05 | Save password and unlock | User.updateOne({ \_id: user\_id }, { \$set: { password\_hash, has\_password: true, is\_login\_locked: false, failed\_login\_attempts: 0 } }) |
| 06 | Consume token, revoke sessions | PasswordResetToken.updateOne({ \_id }, { \$set: { is\_used: true } }); UserSession.updateMany({ user\_id, is\_revoked: false }, { \$set: { is\_revoked: true } }) |

Generic request-validation middleware. Receives a Zod schema, validates req.body and either replaces req.body with the parsed DTO or stops the request with AppError 422 and field errors. Controllers therefore always receive a valid DTO.

| No | Schema (static field) | Description |

##### **ProfileService Class**

Business logic of the profile page (UC05). Keeps the tutor completion flag up to date because tutors cannot apply to requests until is\_complete \= true (UC05 E2, UC12).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getMyProfile | Loads the user and, for tutors, the TutorProfile; adds the completion percentage. |
| 02 | updateBasicInfo | Updates full\_name, phone, avatar\_url (and student\_profile for students). |
| 03 | updateTutorProfile | Updates headline, bio, address, is\_address\_hidden, availability\_status, cover\_url, then recalculates is\_complete. |
| 04 | addTutorItem | Pushes a new experience / education / achievement into the embedded array and recalculates is\_complete. |
| 05 | updateTutorItem | Updates one embedded item by its \_id (positional operator). |
| 06 | removeTutorItem | Pulls one embedded item and recalculates is\_complete. |
| 07 | computeCompletion | (private) Required: headline, bio, availability\_status, at least one education or experience. |

Model of TUTOR\_PROFILES (embeds experiences, educations, achievements).

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |

| 06 | Remove item | TutorProfile.findOneAndUpdate({ user\_id }, { \$pull: { experiences: { \_id: itemId } } }, { new: true }) |

##### **AiSuggestionService Class**

Business logic of AI tutor suggestions (UC09): rule-based matching \+ AI explanation, cache 24 h, AI quota (BR-13).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getSuggestions | Checks the request belongs to the parent and is OPEN; returns the cached list when valid and weights unchanged; otherwise loads candidates, scores them, keeps the top 10, asks the AI Provider for explanations (if quota allows), stores the result with cached\_until \= now \+ 24 h. |
| 02 | findCandidates | (private) Hard constraints: PUBLISHED posts with the same subject, grade and compatible mode; tutor profile complete and AVAILABLE; same area when OFFLINE. |
| 03 | computeMatchScore | (private) Weighted score 0–100 of schedule overlap, budget fit (price vs budget), rating and response rate. |
| 04 | explainWithAi | (private) Checks the user AI quota; calls GeminiClient; on success increments ai\_quota\_used; on error / timeout returns empty reasons and logs the error without consuming quota (E1, BR-13). |

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Load request (owner, OPEN) | ParentRequest.findOne({ \_id: requestId, parent\_user\_id: userId, status: "OPEN" }) |
| 02 | Read cache | AiSuggestion.find({ request\_id: requestId, cached\_until: { \$gt: new Date() } }).sort({ match\_score: \-1 }) |
| 03 | Candidates (hard constraints) | TutorPost.aggregate(\[ { \$match: { status: "PUBLISHED", subject\_name: req.subject\_name, grade\_level: req.grade\_level, teaching\_mode: { \$in: \[req.teaching\_mode, "HYBRID"\] } } }, { \$lookup: { from: "TUTOR\_PROFILES", localField: "profile\_id", foreignField: "\_id", as: "profile" } }, { \$unwind: "\$profile" }, { \$match: { "profile.is\_complete": true, "profile.availability\_status": "AVAILABLE" } }, { \$limit: 200 } \]) |
| 04 | AI quota | User.findById(userId).select("subscription"); Plan.findById(user.subscription.plan\_id).select("ai\_quota") |
| 05 | Consume quota (only on AI success) | User.updateOne({ \_id: userId }, { \$inc: { "subscription.ai\_quota\_used": 1 } }) |
| 06 | Replace cache (transaction) | AiSuggestion.deleteMany({ request\_id }); AiSuggestion.insertMany(top10.map(t \=\> ({ request\_id, tutor\_post\_id, tutor\_profile\_id, match\_score, ai\_reason, weights\_json, cached\_until: now \+ 24h }))) |

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

##### **RequestRoutes Class**

Express router mounted at /api/request/v1. Every route requires authentication; parent routes use authorize(PARENT), job-board routes use authorize(TUTOR).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | GET /me | authorize(PARENT) → RequestController.listMyRequests |
| 02 | POST / | authorize(PARENT) → validator(RequestSchema.createRequestSchema) → RequestController.createRequest |
| 03 | PUT /:requestId | authorize(PARENT) → validator(RequestSchema.updateRequestSchema) → RequestController.updateRequest |
| 04 | PATCH /:requestId/status | authorize(PARENT) → validator(RequestSchema.statusSchema) → RequestController.changeStatus |

##### **AuthMiddleware Class**

Authentication and role authorization (Feature 1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | authentication | Verifies the Bearer token and sets req.user {id, role}. |
| 02 | authorize | Rejects with 403 when req.user.role is not allowed. |

##### **ValidatorMiddleware Class**

Generic Zod validation middleware (Feature 1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | validator | Validates req\[source\]; replaces it with the parsed DTO or returns AppError 422\. |

##### **RequestSchema Class**

Zod schemas of the tutoring request endpoints.

| No | Schema (static field) | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | createRequestSchema | { title: 5–150, student\_id?, subject\_name, grade\_level, description ≤ 2000, teaching\_mode ∈ ONLINE\|OFFLINE\|HYBRID, location\_address? (required unless ONLINE), schedule, budget \> 0, tutor\_requirements? ≤ 1000, image\_urls? ≤ 5, saveAsDraft?: boolean } |
| 02 | updateRequestSchema | createRequestSchema.partial() |
| 03 | statusSchema | { action ∈ CLOSE\|REOPEN } |

##### **RequestController Class**

HTTP layer of tutoring requests and the job board. Reads req.user / params / body / query, calls the services and returns responseCommon.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | listMyRequests | Input: req.user.id, query.status?. Calls RequestService.listMyRequests; returns requests with application counts. |
| 02 | createRequest | Input: body request DTO. Calls RequestService.createRequest; returns 201 with the request and its status (OPEN, or DRAFT with reason). |
| 03 | updateRequest | Input: params.requestId, body DTO. Calls RequestService.updateRequest. |
| 04 | changeStatus | Input: params.requestId, body {action}. Calls RequestService.changeStatus. |

##### **RequestService Class**

Business logic of tutoring requests (UC10) and the job board (UC11). Enforces BR-04 (max 5 open requests, expiry after 30 days) and the content filter (BR-17).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | listMyRequests | Finds the parent requests and joins the number of PENDING / CONTINUED applications. |
| 02 | createRequest | If saveAsDraft → DRAFT. Otherwise checks countOpenByParent \< 5 (E2, 409), runs ContentFilterService.check on title / description / requirements; flagged → DRAFT \+ notification with reason, clean → OPEN. Masks contact data (ContactMaskUtil). |
| 03 | updateRequest | assertOwner; only DRAFT / OPEN requests can be edited; re-runs the content filter. |
| 04 | changeStatus | CLOSE: OPEN → CLOSED and notifies PENDING applicants. REOPEN: CLOSED → OPEN after checking the limit of 5 again. |
| 05 | assertOwner | Loads the request; throws 404 when missing and 403 when parent\_user\_id ≠ userId. |

##### **ContentFilterService Class**

Content filter (BR-17, Feature 2).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | check | Returns {flagged, reason} for banned words, contact data and spam patterns. |

##### **NotificationService Class**

In-app and email notifications (Feature 2).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | notify | Creates a NOTIFICATIONS document and, when "email" is in channels, sends an email. |

##### **ContactMaskUtil Class**

Hides contact information in public texts (BR-15).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | mask | Replaces phone numbers, emails and links with "\*\*\*". |

Data access for PARENT\_REQUESTS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findById | ParentRequest.findById(requestId). |
| 02 | findByParent | ParentRequest.aggregate with \$lookup APPLY\_REQUESTS count – see Database Queries. |
| 03 | countOpenByParent | ParentRequest.countDocuments({parent\_user\_id, status: "OPEN"}). |
| 04 | create | ParentRequest.create(data). |
| 05 | updateById | ParentRequest.findByIdAndUpdate(requestId, {\$set}, {new: true, session}). |

##### **ParentRequest Class**

Model of PARENT\_REQUESTS.

Fields used: parent\_user\_id: ObjectId, student\_id: ObjectId, title: String, subject\_name: String, grade\_level: String, teaching\_mode: ONLINE/OFFLINE/HYBRID, budget: Decimal128, status: DRAFT/PENDING\_MODERATION/OPEN/IN\_PROGRESS/CLOSED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED.

##### **ApplyRequest Class**

Model of APPLY\_REQUESTS (unique request\_id \+ tutor\_profile\_id).

Fields used: request\_id: ObjectId, tutor\_profile\_id: ObjectId, note: String, match\_score: Double, status: PENDING/CONTINUED/SKIPPED/WITHDRAWN.

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image23]

*Figure 22\. Manage Tutoring Requests – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | List my requests with application counts | ParentRequest.aggregate(\[ { \$match: { parent\_user\_id: userId, status? } }, { \$lookup: { from: "APPLY\_REQUESTS", localField: "\_id", foreignField: "request\_id", pipeline: \[ { \$match: { status: { \$in: \["PENDING", "CONTINUED"\] } } }, { \$count: "n" } \], as: "apps" } }, { \$addFields: { application\_count: { \$ifNull: \[ { \$first: "\$apps.n" }, 0 \] } } }, { \$project: { apps: 0 } }, { \$sort: { created\_at: \-1 } } \]) |
| 02 | Check limit of 5 open requests (BR-04) | ParentRequest.countDocuments({ parent\_user\_id: userId, status: "OPEN" }) |
| 03 | Create request | ParentRequest.create({ parent\_user\_id: userId, student\_id, title, subject\_name, grade\_level, description, teaching\_mode, location\_address, schedule, budget, tutor\_requirements, image\_urls, status: draft \|\| flagged ? "DRAFT" : "OPEN" }) |
| 04 | Update request (owner) | ParentRequest.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: requestId, parent\_user\_id: userId, status: { \$in: \["DRAFT", "OPEN"\] } }, { \$set: { ...dto, status } }, { new: true }) |
| 05 | Close / reopen | ParentRequest.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: requestId, parent\_user\_id: userId, status: from }, { \$set: { status: to } }, { new: true }) |
| 06 | Applicants to notify on close | ApplyRequest.find({ request\_id: requestId, status: "PENDING" }).populate({ path: "tutor\_profile\_id", select: "user\_id" }) |
| 07 | Expire after 30 days (scheduled job) | ParentRequest.updateMany({ status: "OPEN", created\_at: { \$lt: new Date(Date.now() \- 30\*24\*3600\*1000) } }, { \$set: { status: "EXPIRED" } }) |

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Tutor profile | TutorProfile.findOne({ user\_id: userId }).select("\_id is\_complete") |
| 02 | Job board | ParentRequest.find({ status: "OPEN", created\_at: { \$gte: now \- 30 d }, subject\_name?, grade\_level?, teaching\_mode?, location\_address?: /area/i, budget: { \$gte: minBudget, \$lte: maxBudget }, \$or: \[ { title: /kw/i }, { description: /kw/i } \] }).select("-image\_urls").sort({ created\_at: \-1 }).skip((page-1)\*limit).limit(limit).lean(); ParentRequest.countDocuments(sameFilter) |
| 03 | Read suggestion cache | AiPostSuggestion.find({ tutor\_profile\_id, cached\_until: { \$gt: new Date() } }).sort({ match\_score: \-1 }).populate({ path: "request\_id", match: { status: "OPEN" } }) |
| 04 | Tutor posts for matching | TutorPost.find({ profile\_id, status: "PUBLISHED" }).select("subject\_name grade\_level teaching\_mode price schedule") |
| 05 | Candidate requests | ParentRequest.find({ status: "OPEN", subject\_name: { \$in: subjects }, grade\_level: { \$in: grades }, teaching\_mode: { \$in: \[...modes, "HYBRID"\] } }).limit(100).lean() |
| 06 | Replace cache | AiPostSuggestion.deleteMany({ tutor\_profile\_id }); AiPostSuggestion.insertMany(top10.map(r \=\> ({ tutor\_profile\_id, request\_id: r.\_id, match\_score, ai\_reason, cached\_until: now \+ 24h }))) |
| 07 | Bookmark / remove | BookmarkedRequest.updateOne({ tutor\_profile\_id, request\_id }, { \$setOnInsert: { tutor\_profile\_id, request\_id } }, { upsert: true }); BookmarkedRequest.deleteOne({ tutor\_profile\_id, request\_id }) |

Generic Zod validation middleware (Feature 1).

##### **ApplicationController Class**

HTTP layer of tutor applications.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | apply | Input: req.user.id, body {request\_id, note}. Calls ApplicationService.apply; returns 201 with the application and the new credit balance. |
| 02 | listMyApplications | Input: req.user.id. Returns the tutor applications with request summary. |
| 03 | withdraw | Input: params.applyId. Calls ApplicationService.withdraw. |

##### **ApplicationService Class**

Business logic of applying (UC12) and responding to applications (UC13). 1 credit is deducted from the tutor when applying; Continue costs nothing; spent credits are never refunded.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | apply | Checks: tutor profile complete, request OPEN (E2), no existing application (BR-05, unique index), \< 10 PENDING applications, content filter on note. In one transaction: CreditService.consume(userId, USED\_APPLY), create application PENDING with match\_score. Notifies the parent. |
| 02 | withdraw | Only the owner tutor and only PENDING → WITHDRAWN; no refund (A1). |

##### **CreditService Class**

Connection credit wallet (shared with Feature 4). The balance is kept in User.credit\_wallet; every change is logged in CREDIT\_TRANSACTIONS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | consume | Atomic \$inc −1 on User.credit\_wallet.balance with condition balance ≥ 1; when no document is modified throws 402 "You need at least 1 credit" (link to UC17). Creates a CreditTransaction {amount: −1, type, related\_apply\_id \| related\_invitation\_id}. Returns the new balance. |

##### **ContentFilterService Class**

Content filter (BR-17, Feature 2).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | check | Returns {flagged, reason} for banned words, contact data and spam patterns. |

##### **NotificationService Class**

In-app and email notifications (Feature 2).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | notify | Creates a NOTIFICATIONS document and, when "email" is in channels, sends an email. |

##### **TransactionUtil Class**

Wraps a MongoDB multi-document transaction.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | runInTransaction | mongoose.startSession() → session.withTransaction(() \=\> fn(session)) → endSession(); rethrows AppError. |

##### **TutorProfileRepository Class**

Data access for TUTOR\_PROFILES (shared).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findByUserId | TutorProfile.findOne({user\_id}). |

Data access for PARENT\_REQUESTS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findById | ParentRequest.findById(requestId). |

##### **ApplyRequestRepository Class**

Data access for APPLY\_REQUESTS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findByPair | ApplyRequest.findOne({request\_id, tutor\_profile\_id}). |
| 02 | countPendingByTutor | ApplyRequest.countDocuments({tutor\_profile\_id, status: "PENDING"}). |
| 03 | create | ApplyRequest.create(\[data\], {session}). |
| 04 | updateStatus | ApplyRequest.findOneAndUpdate({\_id, status: from}, {\$set: {status: to}}, {new: true}). |

##### **UserRepository Class**

Data access for the User collection (shared).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | decrementCredit | User.findOneAndUpdate({\_id, "credit\_wallet.balance": {\$gte: 1}}, {\$inc: {"credit\_wallet.balance": \-1}, \$set: {"credit\_wallet.updated\_at": now}}, {new: true, session}). |

##### **CreditTransactionRepository Class**

Data access for CREDIT\_TRANSACTIONS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | create | CreditTransaction.create(\[data\], {session}). |

##### **ApplyRequest Class**

Model of APPLY\_REQUESTS (unique request\_id \+ tutor\_profile\_id).

Fields used: request\_id: ObjectId, tutor\_profile\_id: ObjectId, note: String, match\_score: Double, status: PENDING/CONTINUED/SKIPPED/WITHDRAWN.

##### **User Class**

Model of the User collection (embedded credit\_wallet).

Fields used: full\_name: String, role: UserRole, account\_status: ACTIVE/SUSPENDED/BANNED, credit\_wallet: CreditWallet.

##### **CreditTransaction Class**

Model of CREDIT\_TRANSACTIONS.

Fields used: user\_id: ObjectId, amount: Int32, type: MONTHLY\_GRANT/PURCHASE/USED\_APPLY/USED\_INVITATION/EXPIRED\_GRANT, related\_apply\_id: ObjectId, related\_invitation\_id: ObjectId, expires\_at: Date.

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image27]

*Figure 26\. Apply to Request – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Request still open | ParentRequest.findById(request\_id).select("status parent\_user\_id subject\_name") |
| 02 | Already applied (BR-05) | ApplyRequest.findOne({ request\_id, tutor\_profile\_id }) |
| 03 | Pending limit of 10 | ApplyRequest.countDocuments({ tutor\_profile\_id, status: "PENDING" }) |
| 04 | Deduct 1 credit (atomic, in transaction) | User.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: userId, "credit\_wallet.balance": { \$gte: 1 } }, { \$inc: { "credit\_wallet.balance": \-1 }, \$set: { "credit\_wallet.updated\_at": new Date() } }, { new: true, session }) |
| 05 | Create application (in transaction) | ApplyRequest.create(\[{ request\_id, tutor\_profile\_id, note, match\_score, status: "PENDING" }\], { session }) |
| 06 | Log credit usage (in transaction) | CreditTransaction.create(\[{ user\_id: userId, amount: \-1, type: "USED\_APPLY", related\_apply\_id: apply.\_id }\], { session }) |
| 07 | Withdraw (no refund) | ApplyRequest.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: applyId, tutor\_profile\_id, status: "PENDING" }, { \$set: { status: "WITHDRAWN" } }, { new: true }) |

##### **AgreementService Class**

Business logic of the optional tutoring agreement (UC16).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | propose | Checks the user is a participant of the DIRECT conversation and the request is not CLOSED (E1); creates the agreement PENDING (or DRAFT) with proposer\_user\_id; notifies the other side. |
| 02 | confirm | Only the other side and only PENDING. In one transaction: agreement → CONFIRMED (accepted\_by\_user\_id), RequestService.closeByAgreement, other open agreements of the request → CANCELLED (proposed by the parent) or REJECTED (proposed by a tutor). Notifies both sides; enables rating (UC36). |
| 03 | reject | Only the other side; PENDING → REJECTED; the conversation stays open (A1). |
| 04 | cancel | Only the proposer; PENDING / DRAFT → CANCELLED (A3). |
| 05 | assertParticipant | Throws 403 when the user is neither conversation.parent\_user\_id nor the owner of conversation.tutor\_profile\_id. |

Business logic of tutoring requests (UC10) and the job board (UC11). Enforces BR-04 (max 5 open requests, expiry after 30 days) and the content filter (BR-17).

![][image35]

*Figure 34\. Confirm Tutoring Agreement – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | My agreements | Conversation.find({ \$or: \[ { parent\_user\_id: userId }, { tutor\_profile\_id: myProfileId } \], type: "DIRECT" }).distinct("\_id"); TutoringAgreement.find({ conversation\_id: { \$in: ids } }).sort({ updated\_at: \-1 }) |
| 02 | Conversation and request | Conversation.findById(conversation\_id); ParentRequest.findById(conv.request\_id).select("status") |
| 03 | Propose | TutoringAgreement.create({ conversation\_id, proposer\_user\_id: userId, agreed\_subject, agreed\_schedule, agreed\_price, status: draft ? "DRAFT" : "PENDING" }) |
| 04 | Confirm (in transaction) | TutoringAgreement.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: agreementId, status: "PENDING", proposer\_user\_id: { \$ne: userId } }, { \$set: { status: "CONFIRMED", accepted\_by\_user\_id: userId } }, { new: true, session }) |
| 05 | Close request (in transaction) | ParentRequest.findByIdAndUpdate(requestId, { \$set: { status: "CLOSED" } }, { session }) |
| 06 | Other open agreements of the request (in transaction) | ids \= Conversation.find({ request\_id: requestId }).distinct("\_id"); TutoringAgreement.find({ conversation\_id: { \$in: ids }, \_id: { \$ne: agreementId }, status: { \$in: \["DRAFT", "PENDING"\] } }, null, { session }) |
| 07 | Cancel / reject the others (in transaction) | TutoringAgreement.bulkWrite(others.map(a \=\> ({ updateOne: { filter: { \_id: a.\_id }, update: { \$set: { status: a.proposer\_user\_id.equals(parentUserId) ? "CANCELLED" : "REJECTED" } } } })), { session }) |
| 08 | Reject / cancel | TutoringAgreement.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: agreementId, status: { \$in: \["PENDING"\] (reject) \| \["DRAFT", "PENDING"\] (cancel) } }, { \$set: { status: "REJECTED" \| "CANCELLED" } }, { new: true }) |

### ***4.1 Upgrade Plan & Buy Credits (UC17)***

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

##### **PaymentRoutes Class**

Express router mounted at /api/payment/v1. Catalog / checkout / result require authentication and authorize(TUTOR, PARENT); the VNPay return and IPN endpoints are public and protected by the signature check.

| 02 | POST /orders | authentication → validator(PaymentSchema.checkoutSchema) → PaymentController.createOrder |

| 04 | GET /vnpay-return | PaymentController.handleReturn (browser redirect from the gateway) |
| 05 | GET /vnpay-ipn | PaymentController.handleIpn (server-to-server IPN) |

##### **AuthMiddleware Class**

Authentication and role authorization (Feature 1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | authentication | Verifies the Bearer token and sets req.user {id, role}. |
| 02 | authorize | Rejects with 403 when req.user.role is not allowed. |

##### **ValidatorMiddleware Class**

Generic Zod validation middleware (Feature 1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | validator | Validates req\[source\]; replaces it with the parsed DTO or returns AppError 422\. |

##### **PaymentSchema Class**

Zod schema of the checkout request.

| No | Schema (static field) | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | checkoutSchema | { item\_type ∈ PLAN\_UPGRADE\|CREDIT\_PACK, plan\_id? (required for PLAN\_UPGRADE), duration\_months? 1–12, pack\_id? (required for CREDIT\_PACK), quantity? 1–10 (default 1), payment\_method ∈ VIETQR\|ATM\_CARD\|CREDIT\_CARD } |

##### **PaymentController Class**

HTTP layer of checkout and the payment gateway callbacks.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getCatalog | Input: req.user.role. Calls PaymentService.getCatalog; returns {plans, packs, currentPlan}. |
| 02 | createOrder | Input: req.user.id, body checkout DTO, client IP. Calls PaymentService.createOrder; returns 201 {order\_code, amount, paymentUrl}. |
| 03 | getOrderResult | Input: params.orderCode. Calls PaymentService.getOrderResult; returns the order status for the Payment Result screen. |
| 04 | handleReturn | Input: query vnp\_\* params. Verifies the signature only to choose the result page and redirects the browser to /payment/result/:orderCode; the order is updated only by the IPN. |
| 05 | handleIpn | Input: query vnp\_\* params. Calls PaymentService.handleIpn; answers the gateway with {RspCode, Message}. |

##### **PaymentService Class**

Business logic of plan upgrades and credit packs (UC17, BR-06): amounts in VND, unique order code, idempotent IPN, pending order expires after 15 minutes.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getCatalog | Returns active plans and credit packs whose target\_role \= role, plus the current subscription of the user. |
| 02 | createOrder | Loads the plan / pack (must be active and for the user role, else 422); computes amount \= monthly\_price × duration\_months or price × quantity; generates order\_code (unique); stores the order PENDING; returns VNPayClient.buildPaymentUrl. |
| 03 | handleIpn | VNPayClient.verifySignature (E2 → RspCode 97, logged); loads the order by code (01 if missing); checks amount (04); if status ≠ PENDING returns 02 (duplicate, idempotent); if created\_at \+ 15 min \< now → EXPIRED. Response code ≠ 00 → FAILED (E1). Success → fulfillOrder in a transaction, returns 00\. |
| 04 | fulfillOrder | Conditional update PENDING → SUCCESS (paid\_at, ipn\_signature). PLAN\_UPGRADE: sets subscription {plan\_id, status ACTIVE, start\_date, expires\_at extended by duration\_months, ai\_quota\_used 0} and grants plan.monthly\_credits (MONTHLY\_GRANT). CREDIT\_PACK: grants credit\_amount × quantity (PURCHASE). Then ReceiptService.generate (after commit). |
| 05 | getOrderResult | Returns the order of the user (404 otherwise) with status and the new balance / plan. |

##### **CreditService Class**

Connection credit wallet (Feature 3); this feature adds grant.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | grant | \$inc \+amount on User.credit\_wallet.balance (creates the wallet if null) and logs a CreditTransaction {amount, type, expires\_at: end of month for MONTHLY\_GRANT}. |

##### **ReceiptService Class**

Builds the payment receipt.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | generate | Renders a PDF receipt (order code, item, amount VND, paid\_at), uploads it through FileStorageClient and stores receipt {receipt\_url, created\_at} on the order. |

##### **NotificationService Class**

In-app and email notifications (Feature 2).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | notify | Creates a NOTIFICATIONS document and optionally sends an email. |

##### **VNPayClient Class**

Adapter of the VNPay Payment Gateway (PaymentGatewayClient).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | buildPaymentUrl | Builds vnp\_\* params (vnp\_TxnRef \= order\_code, vnp\_Amount \= amount × 100, vnp\_ExpireDate \= now \+ 15 min), sorts them and signs with HMAC-SHA512 (VNP\_HASH\_SECRET). |
| 02 | verifySignature | Recomputes HMAC-SHA512 over the sorted params without vnp\_SecureHash and compares (timing-safe). |

##### **FileStorageClient Class**

Adapter of the file storage (Cloudinary / S3).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | upload | Uploads a file and returns its public URL. |

##### **TransactionUtil Class**

Wraps a MongoDB multi-document transaction (Feature 3).

| No | Method | Description |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image37]

*Figure 36\. Upgrade Plan & Buy Credits – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Catalog of the role | Plan.find({ target\_role: role, is\_active: true }).sort({ monthly\_price: 1 }); CreditPack.find({ target\_role: role, is\_active: true }).sort({ price: 1 }) |
| 02 | Create order (BR-06) | PaymentOrder.create({ order\_code: \`TC\${Date.now()}\${rand4}\`, user\_id, item\_type, plan\_id, pack\_id, quantity, duration\_months, amount, payment\_method, status: "PENDING" }) |
| 03 | Find order by code (IPN) | PaymentOrder.findOne({ order\_code: vnp\_TxnRef }) |
| 04 | Mark paid only once (idempotent, in transaction) | PaymentOrder.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: order.\_id, status: "PENDING" }, { \$set: { status: "SUCCESS", paid\_at: new Date(), ipn\_signature: vnp\_SecureHash } }, { new: true, session }) |
| 05 | Failed / expired | PaymentOrder.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: order.\_id, status: "PENDING" }, { \$set: { status: "FAILED" \| "EXPIRED" } }) |
| 06 | Upgrade plan (in transaction) | User.updateOne({ \_id: userId }, { \$set: { subscription: { plan\_id, status: "ACTIVE", start\_date: now, expires\_at: max(now, current.expires\_at) \+ duration\_months, ai\_quota\_used: 0, ai\_quota\_reset\_at: now \+ 1 month, created\_at: now } } }, { session }) |
| 07 | Add credits (in transaction) | User.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: userId }, { \$inc: { "credit\_wallet.balance": n }, \$set: { "credit\_wallet.updated\_at": new Date() } }, { new: true, session }); CreditTransaction.create(\[{ user\_id: userId, amount: n, type: "PURCHASE" \| "MONTHLY\_GRANT", expires\_at }\], { session }) |
| 08 | Store receipt | PaymentOrder.updateOne({ \_id: order.\_id }, { \$set: { receipt: { receipt\_url, created\_at: new Date() } } }) |
| 09 | Expire pending orders \> 15 min (scheduled job) | PaymentOrder.updateMany({ status: "PENDING", created\_at: { \$lt: new Date(Date.now() \- 15\*60\*1000) } }, { \$set: { status: "EXPIRED" } }) |

| 05 | exportHistory | Input: query {format, from, to}. Calls WalletService.exportHistory; streams the file with Content-Disposition attachment. |

##### **WalletService Class**

Read side of credits, plan and payments (UC18).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getSummary | Returns the plan name, status and expires\_at, credit balance, AI quota left (plan.ai\_quota − ai\_quota\_used) and the renewal reminder flag (A1 of UC17). |
| 02 | listTransactions | Credit movements filtered by type and period, newest first, with the related request title for USED\_APPLY / USED\_INVITATION. Empty → empty state with link to UC17 (E1). |
| 03 | listPayments | Payment orders of the user filtered by period. |
| 04 | getReceipt | Only the owner and only SUCCESS orders; returns receipt.receipt\_url (generates it when missing). |
| 05 | exportHistory | Loads transactions \+ payments in the period and builds the file with ExportUtil (A1). |

##### **ReceiptService Class**

Builds the payment receipt.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |

##### **ExportUtil Class**

Builds export files.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | toExcel | Creates an .xlsx buffer (exceljs). |

Data access for the User collection (shared).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |

Data access for PLANS.

Data access for PAYMENT\_ORDERS.

##### **User Class**

Model of the User collection (embedded credit\_wallet and subscription).

Fields used: role: UserRole, credit\_wallet: CreditWallet, subscription: Subscription.

##### **Plan Class**

Model of PLANS.

Model of CREDIT\_TRANSACTIONS.

##### **PaymentOrder Class**

Model of PAYMENT\_ORDERS (unique order\_code).

Fields used: order\_code: String UK, user\_id: ObjectId, item\_type: PLAN\_UPGRADE/CREDIT\_PACK, plan\_id, pack\_id: ObjectId, quantity, duration\_months: Int32, amount: Decimal128, status: PENDING/SUCCESS/FAILED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED, paid\_at: Date, receipt: Receipt.

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image39]

*Figure 38\. View Credits & Transactions – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Plan, balance and quota | User.findById(userId).select("credit\_wallet subscription"); Plan.findById(user.subscription.plan\_id).select("name ai\_quota monthly\_credits") |
| 02 | Credit movements | CreditTransaction.find({ user\_id: userId, type?, created\_at: { \$gte: from, \$lte: to } }).sort({ created\_at: \-1 }).skip((page-1)\*limit).limit(limit).populate({ path: "related\_apply\_id", select: "request\_id", populate: { path: "request\_id", select: "title" } }).populate({ path: "related\_invitation\_id", select: "request\_id", populate: { path: "request\_id", select: "title" } }) |
| 03 | Count for paging | CreditTransaction.countDocuments({ user\_id: userId, type?, created\_at: { \$gte: from, \$lte: to } }) |
| 04 | Payment history | PaymentOrder.find({ user\_id: userId, created\_at: { \$gte: from, \$lte: to } }).select("order\_code item\_type amount status paid\_at receipt").sort({ created\_at: \-1 }) |
| 05 | Receipt (owner, SUCCESS) | PaymentOrder.findOne({ \_id: orderId, user\_id: userId, status: "SUCCESS" }).select("receipt order\_code") |

With agreement\_id (A1) the agreement must be CONFIRMED and involve the tutor; subject / grade are pre-filled. Generates join\_code and invite token (CodeGeneratorUtil, retry on duplicate key), creates the classroom and the class group chat; A1: emails the invite link to the parent. |

##### **ClassroomService Class**

Business logic of classrooms (UC19, UC20, BR-08).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | assertOwner | Loads the classroom; 404 when missing, 403 when not owned by the tutor profile of userId, 409 when ARCHIVED for write actions. |
| 02 | updateClass | assertOwner; capacity cannot go below the number of ACTIVE students. |
| 03 | postAnnouncement | assertOwner; creates the announcement and notifies ACTIVE members. |
| 04 | archiveClass | assertOwner; status → ARCHIVED (read-only, hidden from active lists) (A1). |
| 05 | regenerateCode | assertOwner; replaces join\_code and invite\_link; the old ones stop working (A2). |
| 06 | deleteClass | assertOwner; if ACTIVE members exist and confirm ≠ true → 409 suggesting archive (E1). Otherwise deletes the classroom with members, announcements, materials, assignments and deactivates the group chat in one transaction. |

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Find class by code / link | Classroom.findOne({ status: "ACTIVE", \$or: \[ { join\_code: code.toUpperCase() }, { invite\_link: { \$regex: \`/\${token}\$\` } } \] }) |
| 02 | Already member (E2) | ClassMember.findOne({ class\_id, user\_id: userId }) |
| 03 | Capacity (E2) | ClassMember.aggregate(\[ { \$match: { class\_id, status: "ACTIVE" } }, { \$lookup: { from: "USERS", localField: "user\_id", foreignField: "\_id", as: "u" } }, { \$match: { "u.role": "STUDENT" } }, { \$count: "n" } \]) |
| 04 | Add member | ClassMember.updateOne({ class\_id, user\_id: userId }, { \$set: { status: "ACTIVE", joined\_at: new Date(), removal\_reason: null } }, { upsert: true }) |
| 05 | Parent links child (A1, BR-09) | ParentChildLink.updateOne({ parent\_user\_id: userId, student\_user\_id: childUserId }, { \$setOnInsert: { status: "PENDING" } }, { upsert: true }) |

| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | createSessions | Calls SessionService.createSessions; returns 201 with the created sessions. |
| 02 | reschedule | Calls SessionService.reschedule. |
| 03 | cancel | Calls SessionService.cancel. |
| 04 | markAttendance | Calls SessionService.markAttendance. |

##### **SessionService Class**

Business logic of class sessions (UC26, BR-10).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | createSessions | ClassroomService.assertOwner; one-off or recurring (RecurringRule \+ expandRule); assertNoConflict for every occurrence (E1); insertMany SCHEDULED; notifies members; ReminderService.scheduleFor; CalendarSyncService.pushSessions (async). |
| 02 | expandRule | Generates {start\_time, end\_time} for each selected weekday from the first date to end\_date (Asia/Ho\_Chi\_Minh). |
| 03 | assertNoConflict | Throws 409 with the conflicting session when another SCHEDULED session of the tutor overlaps (BR-10). |
| 04 | reschedule | Owner only, SCHEDULED and not started; assertNoConflict; updates times; reminders rescheduled; calendar updated; members notified (A1). Also used by ScheduleRequestService.approve. |
| 05 | cancel | Status → CANCELLED; pending reminders removed; calendar events deleted; members notified (A1). |
| 06 | markAttendance | After start\_time only; replaces attendance\[\] (students must be ACTIVE members); status → COMPLETED (A2). |

### ***6.4 Connect Google Calendar (UC29)***

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

##### **CalendarRoutes Class**

Express router mounted at /api/calendar/v1. GET /callback is called by Google (user identified by the signed state); the others require authentication.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | GET /status | authentication → CalendarController.getStatus |
| 02 | GET /connect | authentication → CalendarController.connect |
| 03 | GET /callback | CalendarController.callback |
| 04 | DELETE /connection | authentication → CalendarController.disconnect |

##### **AuthMiddleware Class**

Authentication and role authorization (Feature 1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | authentication | Verifies the Bearer token and sets req.user {id, role}. |

##### **CalendarController Class**

HTTP layer of Google Calendar connection (UC29).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getStatus | Returns {connected, last\_synced\_at}. |
| 02 | connect | Returns the Google consent URL (CalendarService.getAuthUrl). |
| 03 | callback | Input: query {code, state, error?}. Calls CalendarService.handleCallback and redirects to the settings page with the result. |
| 04 | disconnect | Input: query.removeEvents?. Calls CalendarService.disconnect. |

##### **CalendarService Class**

Google Calendar connection (UC29).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getAuthUrl | Builds the consent URL (scope calendar.events, access\_type offline, prompt consent) with a signed state containing userId (10 min). |
| 02 | handleCallback | error=access\_denied → "Calendar not connected" (E1). Verifies state, exchanges the code, creates the "TuConnector" calendar, stores tokens encrypted (CryptoUtil), then CalendarSyncService.pushUpcomingForUser. |
| 03 | disconnect | Revokes the token at Google, sets is\_connected \= false and clears tokens; optionally deletes the synced events (A1). |
| 04 | getStatus | Returns is\_connected and last\_synced\_at. |

##### **CalendarSyncService Class**

Pushes session changes to Google Calendar of every connected participant (BR-10: within 1 minute, run in background).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | pushUpcomingForUser | After connecting: pushes all upcoming SCHEDULED sessions of the user classes. |

##### **GoogleCalendarClient Class**

Adapter of the Google Calendar API (googleapis).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | buildAuthUrl | OAuth2 consent URL. |
| 02 | exchangeCode | Returns {access\_token, refresh\_token, expiry\_date}. |
| 03 | createCalendar | Creates a secondary calendar and returns its id. |
| 04 | upsertEvent | Inserts or patches an event (summary, start, end, location / link, reminders 24 h and 30 min); refreshes the access token when expired. |
| 05 | deleteEvent | Deletes an event (404 ignored). |
| 06 | revoke | Revokes the refresh token. |

##### **CryptoUtil Class**

AES-256-GCM encryption of stored OAuth tokens.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | encrypt | Returns iv:tag:cipher (base64). |
| 02 | decrypt | Reverses encrypt. |

Data access for USER\_CALENDAR\_TOKENS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findByUser | UserCalendarToken.findOne({user\_id}). |
| 02 | upsert | UserCalendarToken.updateOne({user\_id}, {\$set}, {upsert: true}). |

##### **SessionCalendarSync Class**

Model of SESSION\_CALENDAR\_SYNC.

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image61]

*Figure 60\. Connect Google Calendar – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Store tokens (encrypted) | UserCalendarToken.updateOne({ user\_id }, { \$set: { provider: "GOOGLE", access\_token: enc(at), refresh\_token: enc(rt), expires\_at, google\_calendar\_id, is\_connected: true, last\_synced\_at: new Date() } }, { upsert: true }) |
| 02 | Upcoming sessions of the user | ClassMember.find({ user\_id, status: "ACTIVE" }).distinct("class\_id") (tutor: own classes); ClassSession.find({ class\_id: { \$in: ids }, status: "SCHEDULED", start\_time: { \$gt: new Date() } }) |

##### **MessageService Class**

Business logic of messaging (UC32, BR-12, BR-14, BR-15).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | listConversations | DIRECT conversations of the user \+ group chats of the ACTIVE classes, with last message and unread count from read\_states. |
| 02 | listMessages | assertAccess; cursor paging on \_id. |
| 03 | sendMessage | assertAccess (readOnly → 409); ignores a client\_id already seen in the last 5 min (resend after reconnect, E1; kept in cache because MESSAGES has no client\_id field); stores the message, touches updated\_at, emits "message:new" to the room; offline recipients (notify\_on\_messages) get a CONVERSATION notification. |
| 04 | uploadAttachment | assertAccess; uploads to storage (BR-12) and returns metadata. |
| 05 | markRead | Upserts read\_states\[user\] and emits "message:read" (read receipts). |
| 06 | shareContact | Only DIRECT parent–tutor conversations (BR-15); sends a CONTACT\_CARD message with the sender phone / Zalo and email. |
| 07 | reportMessage | assertAccess on the message conversation; creates a ContentReport {target\_type: MESSAGE, status: PENDING, severity: MEDIUM} for Admin (UC38). |

Conversations (shared with Features 3 and 5). Membership of a class group chat always follows CLASS\_MEMBERS (no separate participant list).

Socket.IO gateway. On connection it verifies the access token (handshake auth) and joins the rooms user:{id} and conv:{id} of every conversation the user may access.

| No | Method | Description |

| 01 | handleConnection | Verifies JWT; joins user room and conversation rooms; rejects with "unauthorized" otherwise. |
| 02 | emitToConversation | io.to(conv:{id}).emit(event, payload) – "message:new", "message:read". |
| 03 | isOnline | True when the user has at least one connected socket. |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image67]

*Figure 66\. Send & Receive Messages – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | My conversations | Conversation.find({ is\_active: true, \$or: \[ { type: "DIRECT", parent\_user\_id: userId }, { type: "DIRECT", tutor\_profile\_id: myProfileId }, { type: "CLASS\_GROUP\_CHAT", class\_id: { \$in: myClassIds } } \] }).sort({ updated\_at: \-1 }) |
| 02 | Messages page | Message.find({ conversation\_id, ...(before && { \_id: { \$lt: before } }) }).sort({ \_id: \-1 }).limit(limit) |
| 03 | Send | Message.create({ conversation\_id, sender\_user\_id: userId, message\_type, content, attachments }); Conversation.updateOne({ \_id: conversation\_id }, { \$currentDate: { updated\_at: true } }) |
| 04 | Read receipt | Conversation.updateOne({ \_id: id, "read\_states.user\_id": userId }, { \$set: { "read\_states.\$.last\_read\_message\_id": mid, "read\_states.\$.read\_at": now } }) \|\| Conversation.updateOne({ \_id: id }, { \$push: { read\_states: { user\_id: userId, last\_read\_message\_id: mid, read\_at: now } } }) |
| 05 | Unread count | Message.countDocuments({ conversation\_id, \_id: { \$gt: readState.last\_read\_message\_id }, sender\_user\_id: { \$ne: userId } }) |
| 06 | Report message (A3) | ContentReport.create({ reporter\_user\_id: userId, target\_type: "MESSAGE", target\_id: messageId, reason, severity: "MEDIUM", status: "PENDING" }) |
| 07 | Resend de-duplication | The MESSAGES schema has no client\_id field: the client keeps the queue and the server de-duplicates in memory (Redis / cache, 5 min) by sender \+ client\_id. |

##### **ReviewService Class**

Business logic of feedback and rating (UC36, BR-07, BR-17).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | listEligible | CONFIRMED agreements of the parent conversations that have no review yet. |
| 02 | createReview | Agreement must be CONFIRMED, belong to the parent and have no review (E1, 409 "You can rate once per confirmed agreement"); content filter: flagged → 422 with the reason, nothing saved, the parent edits and resubmits (E2, BR-17); otherwise stores the review APPROVED, recalcRating and notifies the tutor. A review goes to PENDING\_MODERATION only when a user reports it (9.2). |
| 03 | updateReview | Owner only and within 7 days of created\_at (else 409); re-runs the filter (flagged → 422, review unchanged) and recalcRating. |
| 04 | reply | Only the reviewed tutor and only once (tutor\_reply empty); content filter (flagged → 422 with the reason); sets tutor\_reply and replied\_at (A2). |
| 05 | recalcRating | average\_rating \= average of APPROVED reviews (1 decimal), stored on TutorProfile. |

Content filter (BR-17, Feature 2).

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image75]

*Figure 74\. Submit Feedback & Rating – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Eligible agreements | convIds \= Conversation.find({ parent\_user\_id: parentId, type: "DIRECT" }).distinct("\_id"); TutoringAgreement.find({ conversation\_id: { \$in: convIds }, status: "CONFIRMED" }); Review.find({ agreement\_id: { \$in: ids } }).distinct("agreement\_id") |
| 02 | Already rated (E1) | Review.findOne({ agreement\_id }) |
| 03 | Create review | Review.create({ tutor\_profile\_id, agreement\_id, parent\_user\_id, rating, knowledge\_rating, punctuality\_rating, communication\_rating, comment, status: "APPROVED" }) – only after the content filter passed |
| 04 | Edit within 7 days (A1) | Review.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: reviewId, parent\_user\_id, created\_at: { \$gte: now − 7d } }, { \$set: dto }, { new: true }) |
| 05 | Tutor reply once (A2) | Review.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: reviewId, tutor\_profile\_id, tutor\_reply: null }, { \$set: { tutor\_reply, replied\_at: new Date() } }, { new: true }) |
| 06 | Recalculate rating | Review.aggregate(\[ { \$match: { tutor\_profile\_id, status: "APPROVED" } }, { \$group: { \_id: null, avg: { \$avg: "\$rating" } } } \]); TutorProfile.updateOne({ \_id: tutor\_profile\_id }, { \$set: { average\_rating: round(avg, 1\) } }) |
