| 02 | moderationActionSchema | { action ∈ APPROVE\|HIDE\|REMOVE\|WARN\_USER\|BAN\_USER, note: 5–500, report\_id? } |

##### **ReportController Class**

HTTP layer of user reports.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | createReport | Input: req.user.id, body. Calls ReportService.createReport; returns 201\. |

##### **ModerationController Class**

HTTP layer of content moderation (UC38).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getQueue | Calls ModerationService.getQueue. |
| 02 | getItem | Calls ModerationService.getItem. |
| 03 | applyAction | Calls ModerationService.applyAction. |

##### **ReportService Class**

User reports. Content is NOT put into moderation by the content filter (the filter only keeps it as DRAFT and notifies the author); it goes to PENDING\_MODERATION only when another user reports it.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | createReport | Checks the target exists and is not the reporter own content; one open report per reporter and target (409). Creates ContentReport {status: PENDING, severity: MEDIUM}. Moves the target out of public view: POST PUBLISHED → PENDING\_MODERATION, REQUEST OPEN → PENDING\_MODERATION, REVIEW APPROVED → PENDING\_MODERATION (+ ReviewService.recalcRating). Notifies the author that the content is under review. |

##### **ModerationService Class**

Business logic of moderation (UC38, BR-16, BR-17).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getQueue | Lists PENDING / INVESTIGATING content reports (each with its target, which is in PENDING\_MODERATION after the report), sorted by severity then date. |
| 02 | getItem | Loads the item with its context (author, related reports, conversation excerpt for a message). |
| 03 | applyAction | Re-checks the item / report is still open (E1 → 409 with latest status). APPROVE (report not valid) → restores PUBLISHED / OPEN / APPROVED (review → ReviewService.recalcRating); HIDE → HIDDEN (post) / CANCELLED (request) / REJECTED (review); REMOVE → DELETED or deleteOne (message); WARN\_USER → notification \+ audit WARN\_USER; BAN\_USER → AdminUserService.changeStatus(BANNED). Resolves the report (action\_taken, admin\_note, resolved\_by\_admin\_id, resolved\_at); audit MODERATE\_CONTENT; notifies the author and the reporter. |

##### **AdminUserService Class**

Business logic of user accounts (UC37, BR-16).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | changeStatus | Blocks own account (E1, 409). Updates account\_status; SUSPENDED / BANNED → revokes all sessions (refresh tokens); writes LOCK\_USER or UNLOCK\_USER to the audit log; notifies the user by email. |

##### **ReviewService Class**

Reviews (Feature 8).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | recalcRating | Recomputes average\_rating from APPROVED reviews. |

##### **AuditLogService Class**

Writes ADMIN\_AUDIT\_LOGS (BR-16).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | log | Creates the audit entry; an admin action without reason is rejected (422). |

##### **NotificationService Class**

Notifications (Feature 7).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | notify | Creates in-app notifications and optional email / SMS. |

##### **ContentReportRepository Class**

Data access for CONTENT\_REPORTS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | create | ContentReport.create(data). |
| 02 | findOpenByReporter | ContentReport.findOne({reporter\_user\_id, target\_type, target\_id, status: {\$in: \["PENDING", "INVESTIGATING"\]}}). |
| 03 | findOpen | ContentReport.find({status: {\$in: \["PENDING", "INVESTIGATING"\]}, target\_type?, severity?}).sort({severity: \-1, created\_at: 1}). |
| 04 | findByTarget | ContentReport.find({target\_type, target\_id}). |
| 05 | resolve | ContentReport.findOneAndUpdate({\_id, status: {\$in: \["PENDING", "INVESTIGATING"\]}}, {\$set}, {new: true}). |

##### **TutorPostRepository Class**

Data access for TUTOR\_POSTS (Feature 2).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | updateStatusIf | TutorPost.findOneAndUpdate({\_id, status: {\$in: from}}, {\$set: {status: to}}, {new: true}). |

##### **ParentRequestRepository Class**

Data access for PARENT\_REQUESTS (Feature 3).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | updateStatusIf | ParentRequest.findOneAndUpdate({\_id, status: {\$in: from}}, {\$set: {status: to}}, {new: true}). |

##### **ReviewRepository Class**

Data access for REVIEWS (Feature 8).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | updateStatusIf | Review.findOneAndUpdate({\_id, status: {\$in: from}}, {\$set: {status: to}}, {new: true}). |

##### **MessageRepository Class**

Data access for MESSAGES (Feature 7).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findById | Message.findById(messageId). |
| 02 | deleteById | Message.deleteOne({\_id}). |

##### **ContentReport Class**

Model of CONTENT\_REPORTS.

Fields used: reporter\_user\_id: ObjectId, target\_type: POST/REQUEST/REVIEW/MESSAGE/USER/CLASSROOM, target\_id: ObjectId, severity: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL, status: PENDING/INVESTIGATING/RESOLVED/DISMISSED, action\_taken: NONE/WARNING\_SENT/CONTENT\_HIDDEN/CONTENT\_REMOVED/USER\_BANNED, admin\_note: String, resolved\_by\_admin\_id: ObjectId, resolved\_at: Date.

##### **AdminAuditLog Class**

Model of ADMIN\_AUDIT\_LOGS.

Fields used: admin\_user\_id: ObjectId, target\_user\_id: ObjectId, action: MODERATE\_CONTENT/WARN\_USER/LOCK\_USER/UNLOCK\_USER/UPDATE\_PLAN/UPDATE\_SETTINGS, reason: String, details\_json: Mixed, ip\_address: String.

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image79]

*Figure 78\. Moderate Content & Reports – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | User report (any role) | ContentReport.findOne({ reporter\_user\_id, target\_type, target\_id, status: { \$in: \["PENDING", "INVESTIGATING"\] } }); ContentReport.create({ reporter\_user\_id, target\_type, target\_id, reason, severity: "MEDIUM", status: "PENDING" }) |
| 02 | Reported content → PENDING\_MODERATION | TutorPost.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: target\_id, status: "PUBLISHED" }, { \$set: { status: "PENDING\_MODERATION" } }); ParentRequest.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: target\_id, status: "OPEN" }, { \$set: { status: "PENDING\_MODERATION" } }); Review.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: target\_id, status: "APPROVED" }, { \$set: { status: "PENDING\_MODERATION" } }) |
| 03 | Open reports | ContentReport.find({ status: { \$in: \["PENDING", "INVESTIGATING"\] }, target\_type?, severity? }).sort({ severity: \-1, created\_at: 1 }) |
| 04 | Apply action (only if still open, E1) | TutorPost.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id, status: { \$in: \["PENDING\_MODERATION", "PUBLISHED"\] } }, { \$set: { status: "PUBLISHED" \| "HIDDEN" \| "DELETED" } }, { new: true }) – same pattern for ParentRequest (OPEN / CANCELLED) and Review (APPROVED / REJECTED); Message.deleteOne({ \_id }) for REMOVE |
| 05 | Resolve report | ContentReport.findOneAndUpdate({ \_id: reportId, status: { \$in: \["PENDING", "INVESTIGATING"\] } }, { \$set: { status: "RESOLVED", action\_taken, admin\_note, resolved\_by\_admin\_id, resolved\_at: new Date() } }, { new: true }) |
| 06 | Audit | AdminAuditLog.create({ admin\_user\_id, target\_user\_id: authorId, action: "MODERATE\_CONTENT" \| "WARN\_USER", reason: note, details\_json: { type, id, action }, ip\_address }) |

### ***9.3 Manage Plans & Pricing (UC39)***

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

![][image80]

*Figure 79\. Manage Plans & Pricing – class diagram*

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

##### **PlanAdminRoutes Class**

Express router mounted at /api/admin/v1/pricing; requires authentication and authorize(ADMIN).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | GET / | PlanAdminController.listAll |
| 02 | PUT /plans/:planId | validator(AdminSchema.planSchema) → PlanAdminController.updatePlan |
| 03 | POST /packs | validator(AdminSchema.packSchema) → PlanAdminController.createPack |
| 04 | PUT /packs/:packId | validator(AdminSchema.packSchema) → PlanAdminController.updatePack |
| 05 | PATCH /packs/:packId/active | validator(AdminSchema.activeSchema) → PlanAdminController.setPackActive |

##### **AuthMiddleware Class**

Authentication and role authorization (Feature 1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | authentication | Verifies the Bearer token and sets req.user {id, role}. |
| 02 | authorize | Rejects with 403 when req.user.role is not allowed. |

##### **ValidatorMiddleware Class**

Generic Zod validation middleware (Feature 1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | validator | Validates req\[source\]; replaces it with the parsed DTO or returns AppError 422\. |

##### **AdminSchema Class**

Zod schemas of the admin endpoints. Every write action carries a reason (BR-16).

| No | Schema (static field) | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | planSchema | { name, monthly\_price ≥ 0, monthly\_credits ≥ 0, ai\_quota ≥ 0, max\_classrooms ≥ 1, sms\_reminders\_enabled, is\_active, reason: 5–500 } |
| 02 | packSchema | { target\_role ∈ TUTOR\|PARENT, name, credit\_amount ≥ 1, price \> 0, reason: 5–500 } (E1) |
| 03 | activeSchema | { is\_active: boolean, reason: 5–500 } |

##### **PlanAdminController Class**

HTTP layer of plans and pricing (UC39).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | listAll | Calls PlanAdminService.listAll. |
| 02 | updatePlan | Calls PlanAdminService.updatePlan. |
| 03 | createPack | Calls PlanAdminService.createPack; returns 201\. |
| 04 | updatePack | Calls PlanAdminService.updatePack. |
| 05 | setPackActive | Calls PlanAdminService.setPackActive. |

##### **PlanAdminService Class**

Business logic of plans and credit packs (UC39, BR-16). New values apply to new purchases and the next monthly credit grant.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | listAll | All plans and credit packs (active and inactive). |
| 02 | updatePlan | Validates values (E1); saves; audit UPDATE\_PLAN with old and new values in details\_json. |
| 03 | createPack | Creates an active pack; audit UPDATE\_PLAN (A1). |
| 04 | updatePack | Updates credits / price; audit UPDATE\_PLAN. |
| 05 | setPackActive | Disables / enables a pack (disabled packs are hidden from the catalog); audit UPDATE\_PLAN (A1). |

##### **AuditLogService Class**

Writes ADMIN\_AUDIT\_LOGS (BR-16).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | log | Creates the audit entry; an admin action without reason is rejected (422). |

##### **PlanRepository Class**

Data access for PLANS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findAll | Plan.find().sort({target\_role: 1, monthly\_price: 1}). |
| 02 | updateById | Plan.findByIdAndUpdate(planId, {\$set}, {new: true, runValidators: true}). |

##### **CreditPackRepository Class**

Data access for CREDIT\_PACKS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findAll | CreditPack.find().sort({target\_role: 1, price: 1}). |
| 02 | create | CreditPack.create(data). |
| 03 | updateById | CreditPack.findByIdAndUpdate(packId, {\$set}, {new: true}). |

##### **AdminAuditLogRepository Class**

Data access for ADMIN\_AUDIT\_LOGS.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | create | AdminAuditLog.create(data). |

##### **Plan Class**

Model of PLANS.

Fields used: target\_role: TUTOR/PARENT, name: String, monthly\_price: Decimal128, monthly\_credits, ai\_quota, max\_classrooms: Int32, sms\_reminders\_enabled, is\_active: Boolean.

##### **CreditPack Class**

Model of CREDIT\_PACKS.

Fields used: target\_role: TUTOR/PARENT, name: String, credit\_amount: Int32, price: Decimal128, is\_active: Boolean.

##### **AdminAuditLog Class**

Model of ADMIN\_AUDIT\_LOGS.

Fields used: admin\_user\_id: ObjectId, target\_user\_id: ObjectId, action: MODERATE\_CONTENT/WARN\_USER/LOCK\_USER/UNLOCK\_USER/UPDATE\_PLAN/UPDATE\_SETTINGS, reason: String, details\_json: Mixed, ip\_address: String.

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image81]

*Figure 80\. Manage Plans & Pricing – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | List | Plan.find().sort({ target\_role: 1, monthly\_price: 1 }); CreditPack.find().sort({ target\_role: 1, price: 1 }) |
| 02 | Update plan | Plan.findByIdAndUpdate(planId, { \$set: { name, monthly\_price, monthly\_credits, ai\_quota, max\_classrooms, sms\_reminders\_enabled, is\_active } }, { new: true, runValidators: true }) |
| 03 | Add / update / disable pack | CreditPack.create({ target\_role, name, credit\_amount, price, is\_active: true }); CreditPack.findByIdAndUpdate(packId, { \$set: { credit\_amount, price } \| { is\_active } }, { new: true }) |
| 04 | Audit | AdminAuditLog.create({ admin\_user\_id, action: "UPDATE\_PLAN", reason, details\_json: { entity, id, before, after }, ip\_address }) |

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

##### **StatsRoutes Class**

Express router mounted at /api/admin/v1/stats; requires authentication and authorize(ADMIN).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | GET / | validator(AdminSchema.statsQuerySchema, "query") → StatsController.getStats |
| 02 | GET /export | validator(AdminSchema.statsQuerySchema, "query") → StatsController.exportReport |

##### **AuthMiddleware Class**

Authentication and role authorization (Feature 1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | authentication | Verifies the Bearer token and sets req.user {id, role}. |
| 02 | authorize | Rejects with 403 when req.user.role is not allowed. |

##### **ValidatorMiddleware Class**

Generic Zod validation middleware (Feature 1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | validator | Validates req\[source\]; replaces it with the parsed DTO or returns AppError 422\. |

##### **AdminSchema Class**

Zod schemas of the admin endpoints. Every write action carries a reason (BR-16).

| No | Schema (static field) | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | statsQuerySchema | { from: date (default now − 30 d), to: date, role?, format? ∈ xlsx\|pdf } |

##### **StatsController Class**

HTTP layer of system statistics (UC40).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getStats | Calls StatsService.getStats. |
| 02 | exportReport | Calls StatsService.exportReport; returns the file as attachment. |

##### **StatsService Class**

KPIs for the admin dashboard (UC40). All counters run in parallel; a period without data returns zeros (E1).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getStats | New users by role, open requests, applications and invitations, conversations opened, confirmed agreements, revenue by item type (SUCCESS orders), active classes, AI usage; daily series for charts. |
| 02 | exportReport | getStats then ExportUtil.toExcel / toPdf (A1). |

##### **ExportUtil Class**

Export file builder (Feature 4).

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | toExcel | Creates an .xlsx buffer. |
| 02 | toPdf | Creates a PDF buffer. |

##### **StatsRepository Class**

Read-only aggregations over several collections for UC40.

| No | Method | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | newUsersByRole | User.aggregate(\[\$match created\_at, \$group role\]). |
| 02 | countRequests | ParentRequest counts by status in period. |
| 03 | countConnections | ApplyRequest and TutorInvitation counts by status; DIRECT Conversation count. |
| 04 | countConfirmedAgreements | TutoringAgreement.countDocuments({status: "CONFIRMED", updated\_at range}). |
| 05 | revenue | PaymentOrder.aggregate(\[\$match SUCCESS \+ paid\_at range, \$group item\_type \+ day, \$sum amount\]). |
| 06 | activeClasses | Classroom.countDocuments({status: "ACTIVE"}). |
| 07 | aiUsage | User.aggregate(\[\$group: {\_id: role, used: {\$sum: "\$subscription.ai\_quota\_used"}}\]). |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image83]

*Figure 82\. View System Statistics – sequence diagram*

#### ***d. Database Queries***

| No | Operation | Query (MongoDB / Mongoose) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | New users by role | User.aggregate(\[ { \$match: { created\_at: { \$gte: from, \$lt: to } } }, { \$group: { \_id: "\$role", n: { \$sum: 1 } } } \]) |
| 02 | Requests / connections | ParentRequest.countDocuments({ status: "OPEN" }); ApplyRequest.aggregate(\[ { \$match: { created\_at range } }, { \$group: { \_id: "\$status", n: { \$sum: 1 } } } \]); TutorInvitation same; Conversation.countDocuments({ type: "DIRECT", created\_at range }) |
| 03 | Confirmed agreements | TutoringAgreement.countDocuments({ status: "CONFIRMED", updated\_at: { \$gte: from, \$lt: to } }) |
| 04 | Revenue | PaymentOrder.aggregate(\[ { \$match: { status: "SUCCESS", paid\_at: { \$gte: from, \$lt: to } } }, { \$group: { \_id: { type: "\$item\_type", day: { \$dateToString: { format: "%Y-%m-%d", date: "\$paid\_at", timezone: "Asia/Ho\_Chi\_Minh" } } }, total: { \$sum: "\$amount" } } } \]) |
| 05 | Active classes / AI usage | Classroom.countDocuments({ status: "ACTIVE" }); User.aggregate(\[ { \$group: { \_id: "\$role", used: { \$sum: "\$subscription.ai\_quota\_used" } } } \]) |
